hypotheses.condition: Smooth integral proper complex fourfold with ample L and projective coarse space
hypotheses.reason: Nondegenerate quadratic form has no projective singular point and cannot factor; Q is projective, L=O_Q(1) ample, and Q is its own coarse space.

hypotheses.condition: Cyclic stabilizer, faithful fiber character, algebraic local coordinates/frame
hypotheses.reason: Q is a scheme with m=1, so character conditions are vacuous; the chart X0!=0 is algebraically A^4 after solving for Y, and X0 is a nonvanishing algebraic frame.

hypotheses.condition: Complete section spaces, not a chosen proper linear subsystem
hypotheses.reason: The restriction sequence and H^1(P^5,O(k))=0 for all integers k identify H^0(Q,O(j)) with the full homogeneous coordinate quotient. Negative degrees have no sections.

hypotheses.condition: All-degree normal form and no hidden cancellation
hypotheses.reason: The relation is monic in X4^2 over C[X0,X1,X2,X3,Y], giving a unique graded basis with a4 in {0,1}. Its distinct initials determine epsilon and b by parity. The smallest initial in any nonzero basis combination cannot cancel.

hypotheses.condition: Full generated lattice, positive degree ray, full-dimensional proper closed cone, bounded degree slices, exponent-orthant projection
hypotheses.reason: Indices of X0 and Xi generate Z^5. Five actual indices for X0,X1,X2,X3,Y span the stated cone with determinant of absolute value 2. Its displayed inequalities imply bounded slices and give the other assertions.

hypotheses.condition: Compatible finite jets realized in sufficiently large admissible degrees
hypotheses.reason: For every |alpha|<=D and j>=D the section X0^(j-|alpha|)*product Xi^alpha_i restricts exactly to z^alpha.

hypotheses.condition: -K_Q=4L, canonical congruence, primitive height-one facets and canonical interiority
hypotheses.reason: Adjunction gives index 4. Congruences are vacuous modulo 1. Coordinate facets and eta=(2,-2,-2,-2,-1) are primitive integral forms taking value 1 at c.
All stabilizers are trivial, hence maximal m=1, and m>=r/N is 1>=4/4.

hypotheses.condition: Inherited K-polystability, minimizing Reeb ray and normalized-volume hypotheses
hypotheses.reason: They are not needed for the explicit section-semigroup computation or shifted-boundary exclusion. A manuscript-level application would still require them.
